svg.title: neoj logo (ink)
svg.desc: Ink version of the neoj wordmark for light backgrounds. Four square tiles, each reduced by one to three straight cuts to form the letters n, e, o, and j. The letters are the positive remains of the squares, and every cut starts at an outer edge: a rectangular notch makes the n, two slots and a short third cut make the e with an inset crossbar, two clipped corners make the o, and a corner cut plus a horizontal slot make the j, separating its dot.
